Review the following terminology related to token quotas:\\n\\n| Term | Definition |\\n| --- | --- |\\n| `InputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of input tokens processed by the model, excluding cached tokens. Token count is estimated based on on-demand pricing; actual token consumption varies by model, input/output ratio, and cache usage. |\\n| `max_tokens` | A parameter you provide in your request to set a maximum amount of output tokens the model can generate. |\\n| Burndown rate | The rate at which input and output tokens are converted into token quota usage for the throttling system. |\\n\\nThe burndown rate for Anthropic Claude models version 4.8 is **15x for output tokens** (1 output token consumes 15 tokens from your quotas) and the burndown rate for Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Fable 5.2 is **10x for output tokens**.
